about: Text in each of the g menu Style's styles (Smart.styled on both keyboards), from Unicode's styled alphabets: what has no styled form stays as it is. "plainBack" lists the styles Plain turns back to the text exactly (upside down is left as it is). UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case and Sentence case change only the letters' case (a word in capitals, "NASA", stays unless everything was in capitals); they are not turned back by Plain. "counts" is what the Style screen says of a text.
